Priyanka Chopra, family arrive in Hyderabad for film shoot

Actress Priyanka Chopra arrived in Hyderabad with her husband Nick Jonas and daughter Malti Marie. The family's arrival is reportedly for the shooting of director SS Rajamouli's upcoming film, tentatively titled 'Varanasi'. The film's shoot is expected to resume with their presence. The specific details regarding the film's production schedule and Chopra's role were not elaborated upon in the coverage.
